$I=\int e^x\left(\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}+\frac{1}{\left(1+x^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right) d x$
Let $f(x)=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}, f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-x \frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}}{1+x^2}=\frac{1}{\left(1+x^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}$
On applying $\int e^x\left(f(x)+f^{\prime}(x)\right) d x=e^x f(x)+c$,
$I=e^x \frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}+c$

questions.solution:
Let $\mathrm{x}^2=\mathrm{t} \therefore \frac{\mathrm{x}^2}{\mathrm{x}^4+\mathrm{x}^2-2}=\frac{\mathrm{x}^2}{\left(\mathrm{x}^2-1\right)\left(\mathrm{x}^2+2\right)}=\frac{\mathrm{t}}{(\mathrm{t}-1)(\mathrm{t}+2)}=\frac{\mathrm{A}}{\mathrm{t}-1}+\frac{\mathrm{B}}{\mathrm{t}+2}$
Solving for A and B to get, $\mathrm{A}=\frac{1}{3}, \mathrm{~B}=\frac{2}{3}$
$\int \frac{x^2}{x^4+x^2-2} d x=\frac{1}{3} \int \frac{1}{x^2-1} d x+\frac{2}{3} \int \frac{1}{x^2+2} d x=\frac{1}{6} \log \left|\frac{x-1}{x+1}\right|+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{3} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x}{\sqrt{2}}+C$
